title: SBPR.QaHarness.T022 request envelope (ADR-0009 §3.2) — M1
description: The authenticated wrapper every control request carries. Mirrors the engine-free RequestEnvelope in qa/SBPR.QaHarness.T022/Contracts/RequestEnvelope.cs. The server additionally binds the ACTUAL delivering peer at a later layer (M2 channels); no channel exists in M1, so this schema describes only the wire shape the arming/admission decision validates. The HMAC is computed over the canonical '\n'-joined field order {nonce, seq, expiry, role, worldUid, verb, requestId} (RequestHmac.CanonicalString) — NOT over this JSON.

nonce.description: Per-run nonce; must equal the armed run nonce.

hmac.description: Lowercase-hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical field string.

role.description: Explicit process role; must match the armed role.

worldUid.description: Disposable world UID; must match the armed world.

requestId.description: Idempotency key; a repeat with the same seq returns the cached decision (replay).

args.description: Named typed argument values for the verb; validated against the verb's argument schema (closed — no undeclared args).
